name: Jaggery oats Cookies
ingredients_raw: Cereal Products (49.6%) [Wheat Flour (Atta) (19.1%), Oats Flour (15.6%), Rolled Oats (14.9%)], Refined Rice Bran Oil, Cane Jaggery (16.5%), Almond Bits (5.5%), Watermelon Seeds (1.8%), Raising Agents (Baking Soda), Oligofructose (Dietary Fibre), Liquid Glucose, Milk Solids, Emulsifiers [Mono and diglycerides of fatty acids (From Rice Bran Oil), Lecithin (From Soyabean)], Thickener [Ethyl cellulose (From Cotton Linter)], Iodized Salt, Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Stabilizer (Xanthan Gum), Vitamins. Contains Wheat, Milk, Soy, Oats, Nut. May Contain Sulphite.
